q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT A.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT A.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW AS A JOIN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) T ON A.FOLLOWEE=T.FOLLOWER GROUP BY A.FOLLOWEE ORDER BY A.FOLLOWEE

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 counts the number of followers for each followee, while Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each followee. In Q1, if a followee has multiple followers, each follower is counted multiple times. In Q2, each follower is counted only once, regardless of how many times they appear as a follower.
